posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
glenn frog knight:

 Also, "end of that timeline" is ominous-sounding… 

Ah! Someone other than me picked up on this. Good.

At the end of the OblivAeon event, we know that all the different multiverses still exsist in some way, but they are all cut off from eachother. This is why post Oblivaeon we are able to follow two different universes that are exactly the same until the destruction (or non-destruction) of Rook City made a branch.

End of that Timeline is ominous indeed! It begs the following question: Is OblivAeon the reason that timeline, and maybe some others, ended abruptly? Or is there perhaps another Actor with the ability and means to destroy/erase evil and destructive timelines?

I'm afraid that, at this time, I will have to leave it there. But I'm very happy you mentioned this GFK as I think it makes for facinating theory material.
